channel.title: Tashfeen Ahmed — Writing
channel.description: Short pieces on designing for agents: keeping the person in charge, prototyping how an agent feels, and putting AI inside the tools people already use.

item.title: Empower, not overpower
item.description: The rule I hold every AI feature to, from Copilot in Word to a lamp that asks students to keep their distance.

item.title: Prototype how the agent feels before deciding what it does
item.description: Why early, rough, interactive prototypes set the direction for Agent Mode, and for most of the projects on this site.

item.title: Agents belong inside the tools people already use
item.description: Copilot in Word, pyReality in Jupyter, a MIDI controller wired into Rekordbox: the same decision, made three times.
